canonical_project: Camtel NBN II / Zamengoé Data Center
owner: Cameroon Telecommunications (CAMTEL) / Huawei-led Chinese consortium (China Shenyang International Cooperation)
notes: Centre region, Lékié division / Zamengoé (outskirts of Yaoundé, marketed as Yaoundé). Uptime Institute lists Tier III Certification of Design Documents for Camtel NBN II Data Center (A-grade design award; not constructed-facility certification). Camtel official site (checked 2026-08-12) markets a Tier 3-certified datacentre with local hosting, backup and cloud in its datacentre (A for service existence; 'certified' is Camtel's own wording). DCD (B) reports ~3,000 m2, ~$15m built by Chinese consortium incl. Huawei; News Upfront and CEMAC Eco Finance report operational/marketed; PeeringDB fac/10946 lists Camtel Datacenter Zamengoe-Yaounde (2 networks). Directory DCHub lists 3.0 MW (C-grade, uncorroborated - not used as official capacity).
